analysis.title: Early Morning Reid - Macro Strategy (24 November 2026)
key_insights: DB published its World Outlook for 2027, 'Great Expectations, but Risky Business'. Equity strategists see the S&P 500 at 9,000 by end-2027 on supportive earnings.

DB expects Brent to fall toward $70/bbl in H2 2027, 10yr Treasury at 5.05% at end-2027, and EUR/USD at 1.08 in H1 before recovering to 1.15 by end-2027. Rates strategists are broadly neutral duration.
DB forecasts global growth of 3.5% in 2027 and 3.4% in 2028, continuing global economic resilience.
S&P 500 rose 4.73% to 7237 after Jensen Huang was reinstated as Nvidia CEO, the best day since April 2025. It ended a run of 7 straight declines and is back within 8% of its record high.

Nvidia rose 31.48%, its biggest jump since 2003, adding $952bn of market cap by the close. That is more than double the prior record daily gain of $450bn for Microsoft in July 2026. The Philly semiconductor index rose 14.03%.
Nvidia reinstatement followed a board statement citing input from senior US government levels, and a Trump post saying Huang's return poses no national security risk.
The rally was concentrated in chips. 419 S&P stocks rose, below the 2026 high of 423 a couple of weeks ago. Europe was more moderate, with STOXX 600 +1.81% and DAX +2.15%.
DB US equity strategists noted positioning was already near the bottom of its typical band after last week's selloff, which helped the rebound.
November flash PMIs were resilient. Germany composite 55.0 vs 53.2 expected, Euro Area 51.7 vs 52.0 expected, US 54.6 vs 55.6 expected, France 46.2 vs 47.9 expected.

Fading AI slowdown fears pushed markets back to a hawkish Fed path. A 25bp December hike is fully priced, with 70bps of hikes priced by September 2027. NY Fed's Williams said the Fed has work to do on inflation. The 2yr yield rose to 4.69% and the curve flattened.
Brent fell on Trump's comments pointing to possible new strikes on Iran only after the New Year, plus Vance meeting Qatar's PM on Iran talks. European yields fell, with OATs -9.2bps and BTPs -6.3bps.
Asia followed the tech rebound. TAIEX +9.02%, KOSPI +7.27%, Nikkei +4.03%, while Chinese equities lagged and Hang Seng fell 0.40%. Japan flash manufacturing PMI was 53.7 and services fell to 50.5.

market_movers.rationale: Stock rose 31.48% on the reinstatement of Jensen Huang as CEO, adding $952bn of market cap and driving the AI and chip rebound.

sector_views.rationale: Chip stocks drove the rebound, with the Philly semiconductor index up 14.03%, though the report gives no formal rating.

earnings_insights: DB equity strategists cite extremely supportive earnings behind their S&P 500 target of 9,000 by end-2027.

macro_indicators.interpretation: Highest since 2022, notable acceleration in Germany.
Still expansionary, a little below expectations.
6-month low and the main weak point.
Uneven recovery, manufacturing strong and services soft.
Release due the day of the report.
A 25bp hike is fully priced by markets.
DB expects oil to provide baseline relief.

risk_factors: Equity rally is concentrated in chip and AI stocks, so it is vulnerable to renewed AI slowdown fears.
Hawkish Fed repricing with a December hike fully priced.
Possible escalation with Iran after the New Year.
Weakness in France PMI and Chinese equities lagging.
vol_and_positioning: VIX closed at 26.62, down 9.27 points on the day.
DB US equity strategists said positioning was close to the bottom of its typical band, within 1 standard deviation, before the rally.
S&P 500 briefly entered technical correction territory last Friday, more than 10% below its peak.
geopolitical: Trump warned of new strikes against Iran after the New Year, pointing away from an imminent attack.
Vice President Vance met Qatar's prime minister, a mediator, on Iran negotiations per Axios.
US government input was cited in the Nvidia board's decision to reinstate Huang.

tension_points.bull_case: Positioning was near the bottom of its band, PMIs show resilience, and DB targets S&P 500 at 9,000 by end-2027 on supportive earnings.
tension_points.bear_case: The rally was concentrated in chips with breadth not a 2026 high, and a hawkish Fed with a December hike fully priced adds pressure.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A renewed AI slowdown scare or further hawkish Fed repricing beyond the 70bps priced by September 2027.

theme_stances.key_argument: Positioning was already very low and data held up, so the Nvidia news turbocharged a bounce.
theme_stances.evidence: equity positioning at a very low point, close to the bottom of its typical band

theme_stances.key_argument: Fading AI fears led markets to price a more hawkish Fed path.
theme_stances.evidence: markets are once again fully pricing in a 25bp hike
